# A&H Techworld

> A&H Techworld is a technology company in Nicosia, Cyprus — a three-person software product
> studio that builds and operates whole products end to end: backend architecture, UX/UI,
> custom integrations, unattended automation and AI integration.

Also written as: AH Techworld, A.H Techworld, A&H Tech World, A and H Techworld, A&H Techworld Ltd.

## Company facts

- **Legal name:** A&H TECH WORLD LTD
- **Trading name:** A&H Techworld
- **Registration number:** HE 494576 (Registrar of Companies, Cyprus)
- **Registered office:** Orfeos 2B, 1070 Nicosia, Cyprus
- **Founded:** 2026
- **Team size:** 3 (one project lead, two developers)
- **Contact:** hello@ahtech.world
- **Website:** https://www.ahtech.world/
- **Serves:** Cyprus and clients worldwide
- **Language:** English

## What it does

A&H Techworld takes on builds other teams decline — undocumented endpoints, legacy databases,
half-finished projects with no original author. The data model is decided first and the interface
follows it. The same three people scope, build and operate each product, so there is no handover
between separate vendors.

Six disciplines under one roof:

1. **Backend architecture** — relational data models, clean migrations, versioned APIs.
2. **UX/UI & interfaces** — mobile-first design against real operational data, not mockups.
3. **Custom integrations** — third-party services behind adapters with retries, timeouts, fallbacks.
4. **Unattended automation** — background queues, idempotent jobs, dead-letter handling, audit logs.
5. **AI integration** — retrieval pipelines, prompt structure, structured output validation, token-cost control.
6. **Product & technical leadership** — scope definition through launch and the operational tail after.

## Work (4 platforms live in production)

- [AutomateOnline](https://www.ahtech.world/work/automateonline): automation platform for recurring
  online work — scheduling, background processing, retries, full audit trail.
- [KibRide](https://www.ahtech.world/work/kibride): ride-hailing platform for North Cyprus —
  passengers, drivers, live tracking, upfront fares, scheduling, one real-time state model.
- [Mituteed](https://www.ahtech.world/work/mituteed): public-facing Estonian web platform built on a
  schema designed to stay legible as the catalogue grows.
- [Säästupark](https://www.ahtech.world/work/saastupark): platform work delivered end to end.
